text:
sam_supply: FYI vendor just quoted a customs retainer + handling fee to fast-track 12 H100s into AMS. asked for $4,200. should we pay or switch forwarder?
lio_ops: how firm is that quote? any cheaper forwarder available that can do the same SLA?
clare_logistics: we have an alternate forwarder who can clear in ~72h for ~$2k but requires full manifest + arrival ETA confirmed. tradeoff: extra admin and risk on carrier handoff.
vivek_vendor: (vendor) quote is real. current forwarder has pickup slot tomorrow but customs backlog is causing potential 7-10 business days delay. retainer covers broker fee + cash deposit for duties.
sam_supply: can you break down the $4.2k? want broker vs deposit vs handling.
vivek_vendor: breakdown: broker expedite $2.8k, refundable duties deposit $1k (kept in broker trust), handling/warehouse $400.
lio_ops: net risk = $2.8k + $400 = $3.2k if deposit returns. do we have precedent approving broker fees under $5k?
clare_logistics: last year we approved $2.5k for a 6-unit rush; finance pushed back but ops argued SLA impact. this is 12 units and will feed Dedicated pool ramp, so time matters.
finance_bot: [automated] GL buckets: PROC-HW, OPS-PROV. Any non-standard prepay needs PO addendum and CFO sign-off over $3k.
sam_supply: ok note: addendum will be required regardless. can vendor accept escrow or PO hold instead of wire?
vivek_vendor: vendor can accept PO addendum + escrow instruction. banker escrow takes 48h to set up though.
clare_logistics: 48h escrow setup plus broker release time might still be faster than full customs queue. we should also consider risk: missing serials or depot damage on early release. request vendor accept RMA responsibility for DOA within 10 days, and cover inbound return shipping.
vivek_vendor: vendor accepts RMA responsibility per standard terms, but will add clause: verified serial manifest required prior to release.
sam_supply: please upload manifest ASAP. also need to confirm insurance endorsement for transit (carrier + customs hold) and insured value matches invoice in EUR.
vivek_vendor: uploading manifest now. snippet:
```
Qty,SKU,SERIAL,AWB
12,H100,HSN200111,WB99887766
12,H100,HSN200112,WB99887766
... (12 rows)
```
lio_ops: manifest looks ok on quick scan. clare, run the depot risk checklist and confirm whether we need photos on acceptance.
clare_logistics: will add photo requirement + depot acceptance form to addendum. also flag VAT reclaim workflow - if customs deposit becomes non-refundable we need documentation to claim.
finance_bot: [automated] Note: FX exposure on vendor invoice (EUR 558k). if we prepay retainer, record under short-term receivable and reconcile on final invoice.
sam_supply: decision: prefer switching to alternate forwarder if they can guarantee 72h and accept vendor handoff. clare, can you secure alternate forwarder quote and paperwork by EOD?
clare_logistics: pinging alt forwarder now. ETA for quote 3h.
vivek_vendor: vendor will continue to hold current forwarder slot for 6h while you decide. after that they will release to marketplace.
lio_ops: ops note: if we split retainer (procurement + ops), get GL codes ready and ensure PO addendum has RMA + insurance + depot-photo clauses.
sam_supply: agreed. also loop in eng-sre: these 12 units are scheduled to join EMEA-dedicated pool 3/28 09:00 UTC. expect hot-join ops window and kube-tagging.
vivek_vendor: vendor confirms insured value equals invoice. will provide insurance certificate once pickup complete.
rma_bot: [automated] RMA ticket created: RMA-90012 for AWB WB99887766. Attach depot photos within 72h of handoff. Failure to attach will delay claim.
clare_logistics: update 1: alt forwarder can do 72h for $2.1k but requires vendor COI and exact handoff address. verdict: cheaper but needs quick vendor signoff.
sam_supply: proceed with alt forwarder if vendor signs the PO addendum and COI. if not signed in 4h, pay retainer to current forwarder to avoid losing the AMS pickup slot.
vivek_vendor: vendor will sign PO addendum and provide COI within 2h. starting paperwork now.
lio_ops: thanks. ops will prepare depot checklist and eng-sre will prep cluster assignment.
sam_supply: closing notes: capture all docs (manifest, COI, escrow/retainer invoice, addendum) in the procurement ticket. we'll log final decision and reconciliation after invoice. :thumbsup:
